[b]How to install:[/b]
-Don't forget to make a backup

[u]Basic Bathrooms[/u]
- Download "Bathroom after 2nd Houseupgrade by DevilBro" then override (FarmHouse2.xnb) & (FarmHouse2_marriage.xnb) in the assigned folder, into your Maps folder. 
- After choosing which version bathroom you want (3 versions to choose from blue, purple and red) then override the farmhouse_tiles.xnb in the assigned folders, into your Content and Maps folder.

[u]Themed Bathrooms[/u]
- Download "Bathroom after 2nd Houseupgrade by DevilBro" then override (FarmHouse2.xnb) & (FarmHouse2_marriage.xnb) in the assigned folder, into your Maps folder. 
- After choosing which version bathroom you want (6 versions to choose from artistic, modern, pink shabby chic, seaside, victorian and vintage) then override the farmhouse_tiles.xnb in the assigned folders, into your Content and Maps folder.
